purpose: Find which electrodes of THIS culture can drive activity and which carry evoked activity, move electrode roles onto them, and fit the spike->action decoder for this culture. Required before any closed-loop use; the simulated weights do not transfer.
steps: 1 baseline: record spontaneous activity, no stimulation

2 probe sweep: single biphasic pulses on every usable electrode (random order, interleaved), measure evoked network spikes; escalate amplitude up the ladder for non-responsive electrodes without exceeding safety.json limits

3 remap: keep each sensory role on its electrode if stimulation there evokes a network response, else move it to the nearest responsive free electrode; keep each motor role if its electrode receives evoked spikes from sensory probes (or is spontaneously active), else move it to the nearest receiving free electrode
4 guided trials: the robot is moved by the teacher (no culture control) while the encoder stimulates the culture with the real observations; record spike counts
5 decoder refit: ridge regression counts -> teacher direction, shrunk toward the sim decoder; accept only if it beats the sim decoder on held-out guided trials
6 save calibration report + calibrated decoder with the session recording

probe.order: random permutation of electrodes per repetition

remap.prefer: original electrode, then nearest by distance

decoder_refit.features: all usable electrodes except sensory (stimulated) electrodes

mock_compressed.note: shortened durations used by `run --backend mock` so a dry run takes seconds

recalibrate: every session; also when success drops > 20 % from the session's post-calibration level
